instruction.text: Sophie wants to put some new wallpaper up in her bedroom. Calculate the area of the walls.

atoms.a: Sophie needs enough blue wallpaper to go around the radiator at the bottom and a picture frame in the top corner. Count the area of wall A in squares so that Sophie knows how much blue wallpaper to use.
Sophie decides to put pink wallpaper up on her other bedroom wall. She needs enough to go around another radiator at the bottom, and a window in the top corner. Count the area of wall B in squares.

instruction.text: Calculate the difference between the total area of wall A and wall B.
Calculate the total area of both walls.
Sophie needs to paint her ceiling white to finish decorating her room. Her ceiling has an area of 16 squares. Draw a square with an area of 16 squares.

The owner of a swimming pool would like to order a new swimming pool cover. He has to know the exact area of the swimming pool so that he can order the correct cover. Calculate the area of the swimming pool in squares.
The swimming pool owner also has a hot tub attached to the pool. He needs to buy a separate cover for it. Count the area of the hot tub in squares.
Count the total area of the pool and the hot tub in squares.
